change.process: Dana's own outreach week at a 1 to 15 person agency: building the list, finding the one true thing to say about each company, writing the note, sending it, following up once. Owner is Dana; nobody else in a shop that size does sales.
change.friction: The research is the whole job and it is the part that gets skipped, so a thousand notes go out saying the same thing and none come back. Clay and Apollo were already bought for this and are already regretted, which means the spend moved and the reply rate did not.

Nothing about someone's business gets sent on a page nobody opened.
